step1_summary.chief_complaint: Experiencing weird symptoms including fatigue, numbness, and weakness.

symptoms.severity: Symptoms include fatigue, weakness, pins and needles in the right hand, and abnormal gait.
symptoms.aggravating_factors: Symptoms have been getting more regular, occurring a couple of times a day.
symptoms.alleviating_factors: Symptoms resolve after a few days.

step1_summary.medications/allergies: Taking aspirin 75 mg daily; allergic to penicillin.
step1_summary.family/social_history: Father has a history of stroke; patient is a doctor working in plastic surgery; lives with wife; does not smoke.
step1_summary.vital_signs/exam_findings: No vital signs reported; patient is currently asymptomatic.
step1_summary.labs/imaging: Previous blood tests for diabetes and cholesterol were normal.
